description: One line per dated thing on the player's calendar, saying who and what in words. Slots are filled from the elections module's contest rows and the family's birth dates; an own part is said of a race the player has filed in. A meeting-plan part is said of a meeting the player has chosen to attend, from that meeting's record.

slots.name: A family member's full name, from their person record.
slots.count: How many seats of that office share the date, from the contest rows.
slots.body: A town or county body's recorded office title (its council or board).
slots.holiday: A federal holiday's name, from the federal calendar's own record (5 U.S.C. 6103).
slots.time: The meeting's start time from its own record, as people say it ("7 p.m.").

parts.text: At {time} you said you'd sit in on the {body}.
parts.author: Story line writer (Sonnet), reviewed by Story lead (Fable)

parts.text: The {body} gavels in at {time} and you plan to be there.
parts.author: Story line writer (Sonnet), reviewed by Story lead (Fable)

parts.text: At {time} you are headed to the {body}.
parts.author: Story line writer (Sonnet), reviewed by Story lead (Fable)
